This '''planet''' located in the [[Atoan system]], in the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]], was covered by crystals. It was inhabited by [[Atoan]]s from the neighboring [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atoa/Legends|Atoa]].

==History==
[[File:Ambush_on_the_Atoan_crystal_planet.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Imperial forces ambushed on the planet.]]

A [[Atoan insurgency|major campaign]] for the Imperials took place in the system shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] were [[Ambush on the Atoan crystal planet|ambushed]] during their search for [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garoche Tarkin]]. In actuality, he had defected to [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Saro]], [[High Priest/Legends|High Priestess]] of Atoa, one of the rulers of the system. Saro and Tarkin were eventually killed by Vader on the planet.
